title: About
text: I’m Gryphon Ferguson, a senior at the University of Nebraska–Lincoln’s College of Journalism and Mass Communications. Originally from Philadelphia, I work as a Student Assistant SID for Nebraska’s Women’s Swim & Dive and Men’s Golf teams. I specialize in sports communications, data journalism, and story creation, which is engaging storytelling to cover collegiate athletics.

title: Run the Dang Ball!
text:
This is a story about running the ball. We are seeing if running the ball is needed to win game


Code
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = fbs, aes(x = rush_ypg, y = wins), color = "#B8AE9C") +
  geom_smooth(data = fbs, aes(x = rush_ypg, y = wins), method = "lm", color = "#2B2B2B") +
  geom_point(data = standouts, aes(x = rush_ypg, y = wins), color = "#E41C38", size = 2.5) +
  geom_text_repel(data = standouts, aes(x = rush_ypg, y = wins, label = team)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(fbs$wins), color = "#8C8C8C") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(fbs$rush_ypg), color = "#8C8C8C") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(70, 310)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2, 19)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = 303, y = 7.8),
    label = "Avg. wins",
    size = 2.5,
    color = "#8C8C8C"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = 180, y = 18),
    label = "Avg. rushing yards",
    size = 2.5,
    color = "#8C8C8C"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = 105, y = 18),
    label = "Winning without the run",
    size = 3,
    color = "#2B2B2B"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = 245, y = 18),
    label = "Running and winning",
    size = 3,
    color = "#E41C38",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = 105, y = -1.5),
    label = "Neither running nor winning",
    size = 3,
    color = "#2B2B2B"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = 245, y = -1.5),
    label = "Running but still losing",
    size = 3,
    color = "#2B2B2B"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = 175, y = -1.5),
    label = "r = 0.45",
    size = 2.5,
    color = "#8C8C8C"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Teams that run the ball more tend to win more",
    subtitle = "Rushing yards and wins are connected, but Air Force shows it is no guarantee",
    x = "Rushing Yards per Game", y = "Wins",
    caption = "By: Gryphon Ferguson | Source: 2025 FBS season data"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "#E41C38"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )











Code
ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = record_avg,
           aes(x = reorder(record_group, avg_rush_ypg),
               weight = avg_rush_ypg, fill = record_group)) +
  geom_text(data = record_avg,
            aes(x = reorder(record_group, avg_rush_ypg),
                y = avg_rush_ypg + 12, label = round(avg_rush_ypg, 1)),
            size = 4, color = "#2B2B2B") +
  geom_text(data = record_avg,
            aes(x = reorder(record_group, avg_rush_ypg),
                y = 12, label = teams),
            color = "white", size = 4) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 220)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Elite (10+ wins)" = "#E41C38",
                               "Middle (.500 or better, under 10 wins)" = "#8C8C8C",
                               "Losing (more losses than wins)" = "#2B2B2B")) +
  labs(
    title = "Elite teams rush for about 45 more yards\nper game than losing teams",
    subtitle = "Number outside each bar = average rushing yards per game\nWhite number inside each bar = number of teams",
    x = "Team Record Category",
    y = "Average Rushing Yards per Game",
    caption = "By: Gryphon Ferguson | Source: 2025 FBS season data"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "#E41C38"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )











Code
elite_offense |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    team = "Team",
    rush_ypg = "Rush YPG",
    def_ypg_allowed = "Yards Allowed YPG",
    wins = "Wins",
    losses = "Losses"
  ) |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Most Elite Teams Ran the Ball, but a Few Won Without It",
    subtitle = "2025 FBS teams with 10+ wins. 20 of 25 rushed for more than the FBS average of 158 yards per game. Navy led at 285.6, while Alabama won 11 games on just 104.1."
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(rush_ypg, def_ypg_allowed),
    decimals = 1
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(color = "black", weight = "bold", align = "left"),
    locations = cells_title("title")
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(color = "black", align = "left"),
    locations = cells_title("subtitle")
  ) |>
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md("**By:** Gryphon Ferguson  |  **Source:** 2025 FBS season data")
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = everything()),
    style = list(
      cell_borders(sides = "bottom", weight = px(3)),
      cell_text(weight = "bold", size = 12)
    )
  ) |>
  opt_row_striping() |>
  opt_table_lines("none") |>
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "#00205B"),
      cell_text(color = "white")
    ),
    locations = cells_body(rows = team == "Navy")
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "#CC0000"),
      cell_text(color = "white")
    ),
    locations = cells_body(rows = team == "Utah")
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "#990000"),
      cell_text(color = "white")
    ),
    locations = cells_body(rows = team == "Indiana")
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "#9E1B32"),
      cell_text(color = "white")
    ),
    locations = cells_body(rows = team == "Alabama")
  )
